globalContext.framework: Equation of Exchange (M * V = P * Y) & Sovereign Debt Issuance Duration Profiling
globalContext.primaryTransmissionChannel: T-Bill Issuance Tilt Drains ON RRP and Suppresses 10Y Term Premium; Velocity Acceleration Dictates Real CPI Pass-Through of Central Bank Balance Sheet Expansion

activeAlerts.headline: ⚡ Shadow QE Active: T-Bills at 21.6% of Marketable Debt
activeAlerts.body: US Treasury issuance mix exceeds the TBAC 15-20% guideline band, keeping an estimated 3.4 bps of term premium suppressed on the 10-Year Treasury bond.

activeAlerts.headline: ⚠️ ON RRP Buffer Critical: $142.5B Remaining
activeAlerts.body: Money Market Funds have nearly exhausted idle reverse repo cash to absorb T-Bills. Ongoing bill reliance will now drain commercial bank reserves.

activeAlerts.headline: 📈 M2 Velocity Consolidates at 1.368 After Historic 1.12 Trough
activeAlerts.body: Unlike the 2010s post-GFC disinflationary trap where velocity collapsed to 1.43, post-pandemic money circulation remains firm, sustaining core inflation resilience.
